answer: An electrolytic cell uses electrical energy to drive a chemical reaction.
An electric current drives a non-spontaneous redox reaction in an electrolyte; oxidation occurs at the anode and reduction at the cathode.
A dilute halide solution generally produces oxygen at the anode, while a concentrated solution produces the halogen; hydrogen forms at the cathode in both cases.

answer: It is an arrangement of metals by increasing reduction potentials; a metal higher in the series has a lower reduction potential and greater tendency to lose electrons.
